### Centroid arguments

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}

::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--centroid_nsides`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Number of sides of the polygon to be created around each centroid coordinate to represent the cell shape.
If not provided, circles will be created.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--centroid_radius`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Radius of the shape around each centroid coordinate to represent the cell shape.
If not provided, Seurat computes a default based on the centroid coordinates.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--centroid_theta`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Angle to adjust the shapes around each centroid when plotting.
If not provided, no adjustment will be made (theta = 0)
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.7.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/convert/from_h5mu_to_seurat_with_fov/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline_spatial/v0.7.0/components/convert/from_h5mu_to_seurat_with_fov);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.7.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/convert/from_h5mu_to_seurat_with_fov/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
